system.description:
The ascetics of the Hollow Mountain and other remote places, who practise alone, with no students and no lineage.

  • Mountain Communion: on a turn in which you do not move, the target of your Stun Attack has Disadvantage on its save. Fast Healing doubles when you meditate outdoors in natural surroundings for 12 hours.
    • 9th level: on a turn you do not move, the first attack against you before your next turn has Disadvantage.
  • Unshaken Mind: you have Iron Mind from 1st level, not 8th.
    • 8th level: when you succeed on a Will save, the creature that forced it has Disadvantage on its save against your next Stun Attack before the end of your next turn.
